25(L + 25) = 13750 + 825
⇒ L + 25 = 583 ⇒ L = 558 cal g–1

questions.question: If a concave mirror having focal length 12 cm is divide in two parts as shown in diagram the separation between the images formed in upper and lower part will be :- (object is at C)

Object distance u = – 2f = – 24 cm (since C = 2f)
Separation in images = magnification × separation in parts

Object is at C, so image is at also C and of same size (real and inverted) for both parts.
The two parts are separated vertically by 2 cm (distance between upper and lower part centers) The image distance for each part forms at the same object distance but shifted vertically due to the 2 cm separation.
Using magnification m = –1 (image inverted and same size)
Vertical separation between images = magnification × vertical separation of parts = |–1| × 2 cm = 2 cm
But here, actual lateral displacement equals twice the separation due to symmetry.
Reconsidering, when mirror is divided and object is on axis at C, vertical shift in images formed is twice the separation of mirrors, so:
Separation between images = 2 + 2 cm = 4 cm

questions.question:
Assertion : Microwaves have less energy than visible waves.
Reason : Microwaves move faster than visible waves.
options: Both Assertion & Reason are True & the Reason is a correct explanation of the Assertion.
Both Assertion & Reason are True but Reason is not a correct explanation of the Assertion.
Assertion is True but the Reason is False.
questions.explanation:
Energy of an EM wave is proportional to its frequency: E = hν. Microwaves have lower frequency than optical waves, so their energy is smaller.
However, all electromagnetic waves travel at the same speed in vacuum (c ≈ 3 × 108 m/s), so the statement “microwaves move faster than optical waves” is incorrect.

Final answer:  Option 3
